title: HUMANS CONNECT
description:
HUMANS CONNECT

An action-packed Boss-Rush Game, each character has a unique set of moves and abilities. To unlock all the characters mythos and the lore of the game, you must beat the chapters.

Character Description

NightWolf:
A loyal wolf pet-like creature with a purpose of protecting his masters from any harm.

Julia:
Unaware of the power lurking inside her, Julia is a brave young girl, always willing to risk her life for others.

Inpu:
A creature that resembles Anubis, with a mysterious purpose. Inpu stumbles on Julia and suddenly decides to take her away because he sensed something dangerous from her.

This game has been entirely developed by a Single Person.
description_short: STORY TELLING BOSS RUSH. Humans, animals, or both. What and who are they? In a world known to be inhabited by both. Beings more than humans and animals. Shrouded in mystery. Connected either through mythology or paranormal. Discover through the narrative of "HUMANS CONNECT"
